source.title: iPhone Air Dimensional Drawings
source.extracted_by: sheet 1: text is vector outlines with no font, read off pdf-crop renders. sheets 2-4: ~/Projects/Assets/cad/extract/pdf-text.py plus pdf-crop for the view mapping
source.coordinate_note: pages carry no cover sheet and are drawn rotated; renders are turned -90 degrees before reading

datum.origin: top-left corner of the product outline, viewed from the front
datum.x: +X toward the right edge; product spans x 0 .. 74.7
datum.y: -Y down the length; product spans y 0 .. -156.18
datum.z: z 0 at the front cover-glass plane; -Z into the body. Back face at z = -5.64
datum.confirmed_by: island, receiver, usb-c and magsafe centred on x 37.35, printed PRODUCT CENTER

edge_profile.label: detail B, PROFILE (ALL SIDES)
edge_profile.pairing_note: paired by count and tick order in detail B; the 2.58 row matches the 2.58 flat-area inset at the faces
edge_profile.face_inset_note: ALL AROUND 2.58, exterior of housing to start of flat area on top side of product

corner.type: continuous curvature (squircle), not a circular arc
corner.source: detail A, CORNER PROFILE (ALL FOUR CORNERS)
corner.plane: XY plan view; x across the width from the side edge, y along the length from the end edge
corner.dimensioned_points_note: the table is symmetric about the diagonal; points paired smallest x with largest y

margins.note: ALL AROUND 2.58, exterior of housing to display active area

button_cross_section.source: 3X 2.35 on the left view, 2.35 / 2.53 / 2.82 on the right view

recommended_connector_keepout.requirement: mating connector keepout area flush to product surface required outward 14.0 mm

ports.note: 4X 1.10 ports; labelled BOTTOM MIC 1 and BOTTOM MIC 2, the other two carry no role
ports.centre_source: 6X 2.71 across the thickness, shared by the four ports and two screws

top_edge.note: callouts are across the thickness; not traced to z

rear_camera.label: detail D, back-facing
rear_camera.plateau_note: the plateau spans the full width at the top; its outline carries no printed ordinates. Mic and flash share the lens row.

keepout_cones.source: sheet 3 detail N, sections S-S, T-T, U-U. Paired base diameters are T-T then U-U.

camera_control.label: sheet 2 detail E, detail F, sections G-G, H-H, J-J, K-K, L-L
camera_control.rule: avoid narrow edges or acute angles in order to preserve tactile feel at this edge

front_sensors.label: sheet 3 detail M, sections P-P and R-R

inner_zone.rule: no metal, conductive material, or magnetic material

outer_zone.rule: no magnetic or permeable material except MagSafe magnets
outer_zone.clip: full width band from y -34.17 to y -113.75, then the R49.39 arc

camera_keepout_region.rule: no metal or other conductive material, full product volume including side walls

antenna_keepouts.rule: no metal or other conductive material, full product volume including side walls
antenna_keepouts.frame_note: sheet 4 view 1, back-facing. x is product-frame; x_back keeps the printed ordinates.

rear_glass_keepouts.name: keepout_1
rear_glass_keepouts.rule: do not obstruct this area with metal or other conductive material; non-conductive material to be uniform in thickness

rear_glass_keepouts.name: keepout_2
rear_glass_keepouts.rule: do not obstruct this area with metal or other conductive material; non-conductive material to be uniform in thickness

rear_glass_keepouts_note: sheet 4 view 3, note 8. Sections KEEP OUT AREA 1 and 2 show a 100 degree cone off the back glass.

design_notes.text: Do not obstruct the imaging features: front camera, rear camera, rear flash.
Do not obstruct forward facing sensors.
Relative magnetic permeability of any metal used on case: 1.05 max, per ASTM A342/A342M-14.
No magnets on rear of product except MagSafe magnets.
Case thickness on backside of product: 2.1 mm max to ensure full functionality.

unverified: sheet 1 values are read off rendered crops, not cross-checked against the vector geometry
edge_profile pairing and corner point pairing are by count and tick order, not solved
bottom port roles: BOTTOM MIC 1 and 2 leaders assigned to the outer ports
usb-c keepout inner_height 2.60 and centre 2.70 assigned from detail C by position
rear mic and flash y taken from the lens row; detail D prints only their x
front sensor keepout centre x 39.99 is the only unassigned x ordinate in detail M
antenna top_block y span and the top band's extent under the camera

frames.product_frame: x 0..74.7 measured from the product's left edge viewed from the FRONT, as datum declares.
front_facing_views: sheet 1 front, left, right and bottom views
back_facing_views: sheet 1 back view and detail D
frames.identified_by: the camera plateau's lens sits top-left in a back-facing view
frames.rule: an x ordinate read in a back-facing view is 74.7 - x in the product frame. y is unaffected.
frames.affects: rear_camera, compass, camera_keepout_region, antenna_keepouts, rear_glass_keepouts and rear_logo. Their printed x is kept as x_back.
